organization.name: D-CORE OPERATIONS
organization.tagline: Technology at the Core. Operations at Scale.
organization.description: Technology and digital operations team managing requirements, platforms, infrastructure, and projects for DMK.

projects.name: Periyar.net
projects.description: Digital archive and educational repository platform for Periyar thought, historical literature, and public research.
notes: CDN edge caching implemented for high volume archival documents.
OCR text extraction integration scheduled for Q4.

projects.name: Makkalveeran.com
projects.description: Community engagement platform and digital publication network for public outreach and announcements.
notes: Mobile responsive redressing passed preliminary QA.
Push notification engine undergoing stress testing.

projects.name: Kalaignar.org
projects.description: Official memorial & legacy portal showcasing historical contributions, digitized speeches, and interactive timeline.
notes: Primary server cluster hardware migration completed successfully.
High availability load balancers configured for peak traffic.

projects.name: TVK Files
projects.description: Centralized digital asset management, document storage, and media repository system for verified operational assets.
notes: S3 compatible storage tier setup finished.
Metadata indexing framework under active review.

projects.name: Legal Support System for Pro Party Members
projects.description: Legal support system, case tracking management, and legal assistance portal for pro party members and advocates.
notes: Case tracking portal live at portal-tomebhnc.onslate.com.
Court case daily monitoring integration in progress.

projects.name: Party Volunteer Verification System
projects.description: Field volunteer verification system for civic reports, party member validation, and on-ground operational authentication.
notes: Live volunteer verification system at verification-system-six.vercel.app/x.
RTI report endorsement module integration underway.

tasks.title: Website Infrastructure & Failover Upgrade
tasks.description: Deploy dual-region redundant server instances and automated DNS failover for Kalaignar.org high traffic load.
tasks.notes: Primary node synced. Edge proxies responding within 18ms.

tasks.title: Archival Document Indexing Engine
tasks.description: Optimize elastic search queries for historical document search on Periyar.net.
tasks.notes: Query latency reduced by 40% in initial benchmark tests.

tasks.title: Mobile Navigation & Touch Interface Audit
tasks.description: Refactor navigation UI for Makkalveeran.com to ensure seamless touch interactions on mobile devices.
tasks.notes: PR submitted for review by design team lead.

tasks.title: Role-Based Storage Access Security Hardening
tasks.description: Implement granular OAuth2 scopes and signed URLs for document access on TVK Files.
tasks.notes: Architectural spec finalized. Implementation starting next sprint.

tasks.title: Legal Case Tracking & Daily Court Hearing Monitor
tasks.description: Single-view module tracking daily court cases, argument summaries, hearing outcomes, and legal orders.
tasks.notes: Integrated into Legal Support System portal.

tasks.title: Party Volunteer Identity Validation & RTI Integration
tasks.description: Verification engine linking party field volunteers with RTI report endorsements and ground checks.

tasks.title: Interactive Speech Timeline Video Sync
tasks.description: Integrate HTML5 video player with synchronized transcript markers for historical speeches.
tasks.notes: Deployed to production and tested on Chrome/Safari/Firefox.

tasks.title: Advocate Directory & Emergency Legal Helpline Integration
tasks.description: Emergency advocate lookup and automated legal assistance ticketing system for party members.

tasks.title: Ward Level Volunteer Badge & QR Auth Scanner
tasks.description: Mobile QR authentication scanner for party volunteers during ward-level civic verification drives.

ideas.title: AI Student Data & Resource Repository (Casteless Society)
ideas.description: AI-driven student data repository, educational tools, and scholarship requirement manager for building an egalitarian, casteless society.
ideas.notes: Requirements document mapped. Aimed at providing equal educational opportunities and AI tools for students.

ideas.title: RTI Report Endorsement & Civic Verification System
ideas.description: Integration framework to onboard RTI activists and endorse verified RTI reports directly into the civic verification tool.
ideas.notes: Linked with party volunteer verification system for field RTI report validation.

ideas.title: Legal Wing Daily Court Case Monitoring Dashboard
ideas.description: Single-view portal tracking daily hearing dates, case arguments, hearing outcomes, case history, court orders, and legal documents for the DMK Legal Wing.
ideas.notes: Enhancement for the Legal Support System portal (portal-tomebhnc.onslate.com). Enables full case lifecycle tracking.

ideas.title: Kalaignar Writings & Historical Speeches OCR Digitization
ideas.description: High-precision OCR conversion pipeline to digitize legacy Tamil books, speeches, and manuscripts of Kalaignar Karunanidhi into searchable text.
ideas.notes: Evaluation of Tamil Tesseract OCR and custom neural recognition models for historical print styles.

ideas.title: DMK Representative Social Media Analytics Network
ideas.description: Comprehensive social media analytics dashboard tracking performance, reach, and engagement across accounts of DMK MLAs, ex-MLAs, Ministers, and District Secretaries.
ideas.notes: Centralized dashboard tracking engagement metrics, follower growth, and post frequency.

ideas.title: DMK Cadre Direct Connection & Engagement App
ideas.description: Mobile application establishing direct connection between DMK leadership and all party members & supporters with daily engagement streaks and participation bars.
ideas.notes: Includes engagement bar tracking and direct message broadcasts from party leadership.

ideas.title: Youth Wing & Frontal Wings Digital Portal Network
ideas.description: Dedicated web platforms for DMK Youth Wing and all wings, appointing SM incharges per wing to monitor and boost digital footprint across all platforms.
ideas.notes: Minimum 5 influencers per wing added to advisory group with dedicated SM coordinators.

ideas.title: Ward Level Hyper-Local Issues Tracker
ideas.description: Ground-level issue tracking network appointing 1 coordinator per ward to log, monitor, and resolve hyper-local civic problems.
ideas.notes: 1 person per ward structure integrated with central D-Core operations desk.

ideas.title: Auto Social Media Post Scheduler (Cogsend Integration)
ideas.description: Open-source based social media scheduling platform (forked from Cogsend / Zoho integration) for automated multi-channel DMK content publishing.
ideas.notes: Forking github.com/Interpoolx/cogsend for automated queue management.

ideas.title: DMK Achievements & Popular Video/Meme Reference Vault
ideas.description: Ready-reference digital repository of DMK governance achievements, video clips, meme templates, and structured answers to political controversies.
ideas.notes: Categorized vault for instant media creation and rapid response.

ideas.title: AI-Mapped DMK Writers & Content Creators Network
ideas.description: Directory of DMK social media writers and creators, cataloging their best indexed works accessible through an AI search interface.
ideas.notes: AI semantic search mapping top articles, tweets, and scripts.

ideas.title: Master Campaign Narratives & Strategic Intelligence Dashboard
ideas.description: Intelligence dashboard tracking DMK narrative strength, opposition strategy shifts, and campaign narrative counter-measures in real time.
ideas.notes: Real-time topic tracking, sentiment monitoring, and counter-narrative formulation.

ideas.title: Kalaignar Historical Speeches & Assembly Debate Vault
ideas.description: Digitized audio, video, and transcript vault of all past assembly and public speeches of Kalaignar Karunanidhi.
ideas.notes: Includes speech indexing, OCR transcript search, and video clip tagging.

ideas.title: Campaign Strategy Psychological Advisory Unit
ideas.description: Specialized advisory panel integrating psychological experts to evaluate voter sentiments and formulate communication strategies.
ideas.notes: Advisory unit of 2-3 psychological experts for strategy guidance.

ideas.title: AI-Powered Archival Document Search & Summarization
ideas.description: Implement an intelligent semantic search agent leveraging LLM embeddings to allow researchers to query historical speeches, essays, and archival documents in natural Tamil/English.
ideas.notes: Evaluated sentence-transformers with Tamil embeddings. Initial retrieval precision looks promising.

ideas.title: Automated Infrastructure Health Monitoring & Alerting Bot
ideas.description: Unified NOC dashboard bot that monitors uptime, CPU usage, and bandwidth across all D-Core ecosystem domains and broadcasts instant alerts via Telegram/WhatsApp webhook.
ideas.notes: Approved for Q4 implementation. Can be converted into a standalone project.
